title: From an intrinsic presentation witness to canonical actual completeness
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $d$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum over $A$ with finitely generated ideal $I$ and finite perfect quotients [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Work on the chosen small pro-etale presentation, with coefficient universe one above the scheme universe and actual completed coefficient ring $A_X$. Let $E$ be the specified exact scalar-preserving equivalence from actual $A_X$-module sheaves to module sheaves over the constant completed ring in the small-site presentation [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-coefficient-equivalence], and let $F$ be its derived equivalence. Let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$. Suppose there exist a finite tuple $b$ generating $I$, a complex $C$ of presentation modules and an isomorphism $j:Q(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(M)$ such that the explicit completed-coefficient Koszul fiber unit on $C$ for $b$ is invertible after localization. This is the intrinsic-completeness witness used in the integral constructible category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete].

Then for every finite tuple $a$ generating $I$, every actual completed-coefficient cochain representative $D$ and every isomorphism $i:Q(D)\xrightarrow{\sim}M$, the specified actual intrinsic unit $\eta_{a,D,i}:M\to M^{\wedge}_{a,D}$ of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is an isomorphism. In particular this holds for the stipulated generator tuple and the canonical representative used by the Koszul reflector [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. It also implies invertibility of the canonical strict quotient-tower completion unit of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Consequently the underlying object of every integral bounded constructible complete object satisfies that canonical actual completeness predicate. No additional hypothesis on $X$, the representatives or the generating tuple is imposed.

proof.text: Write $\tau_M:M\to\operatorname{Rlim}M_\bullet$ for the canonical strict quotient-tower completion unit of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback at the identity of $X$: the unit $M\to\operatorname{Rlim}\Delta M$ of the constant-tower/derived-limit adjunction followed by $\operatorname{Rlim}$ of the strict quotient augmentation $\Delta M\to M_\bullet$. The hypothesis of the item, a finite generating tuple $b$, a presentation complex $C$ and $j:Q(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(M)$ along the specified scalar-preserving coefficient equivalence with invertible localized Koszul fiber unit, is exactly the existential Koszul witness of intrinsic completeness in def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete. This is the hypothesis of lem-weil-pbc-intrinsic-to-tower-complete, which needs only the adic coefficient datum and imposes no hypothesis on $X$, a morphism, properness or etale origin. Its conclusion is that this composite $\tau_M$ is invertible, i.e. $M$ is tower complete in the sense of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback. This proves the clause on the canonical strict quotient-tower completion unit.

source.place: base proof Step 10 (wfConstructible_complete); agent-written reduction to the existing tower-completeness and Koszul/quotient comparison nodes

proof.text: Fix any finite tuple $a$ generating $I$, any actual completed-coefficient cochain complex $D$ and any isomorphism $i:Q(D)\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. Apply lem-weil-pbc-completed-koszul-quotient-comparison to $K=M$, $C=D$, $e=i$; it imposes no completeness hypothesis. It gives an isomorphism $c:M^{\wedge}_{a,D}\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Rlim}_n(M\otimes^L_{A_X}(A/I^{n+1})_X)$ from the intrinsic Koszul completion of def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion such that $\eta_{a,D,i};c$ equals the constant/limit-adjunction unit followed by $\operatorname{Rlim}$ of the strict quotient augmentation. The tower indexed by $n\ge0$ with $A/I^{n+1}$ is the reduction tower $(M\otimes^L P_n)_{n\ge1}$ of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback reindexed, with the same transitions and augmentation, so the right side is $\tau_M$. Hence $\eta_{a,D,i}=\tau_M;c^{-1}$, a composite of two isomorphisms by Step 1, so $\eta_{a,D,i}$ is an isomorphism. No relation between $a$ and $b$ beyond generating $I$, and no relation between $D$ and $C$, is used.

proof.text: The stipulated generator tuple of $I$ and the canonical representative of $M$ with its identification used by the Koszul reflector lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector (with $\mathcal O=A_X$ and the global sections given by the images of the tuple) are one admissible choice of $a,D,i$ in Step 2, so their unit is invertible. Nothing about the reflector's universal property is used.

proof.text: Let $K$ be an object of the integral bounded constructible complete category of def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete. Its first membership condition is intrinsic completeness, in the existential presentation-witness form of the item's hypothesis; it supplies $b,C,j$ with invertible presentation unit for the underlying object. Steps 1--2 then give invertibility of $\tau_K$ and of every actual unit $\eta_{a,D,i}$. The valuation-ring and noetherian finite-dimensional hypotheses of that category are special cases of the adic datum, and its uniform-constructibility and compatible etale-origin conditions are not used.
